instruction.text: Raina Rainmaker and Edgar Earthworm are going out to give the land some rain. Choose the right advice for them before a full day out.

b.sound: Eat a good breakfast before you leave, and pack some lunch and snacks for energy. Don’t forget to bring enough water too!
Wait until you’re back home after the day ends to eat and drink.

feedback.end: When we are working hard, our body needs a lot more food and water than usual. It’s important to eat and drink regularly throughout the day!

instruction.text: Help Raina pack her bag for the day. Drag the food and water to her bag.
Raina is panting and sweating after flying around for so long. What does her body need? Choose the right advice for her.

b.sound: You’re getting out of breath from all the hard work. You should rest to get your breath back and drink lots of water.
You should put a snorkel on and continue flying around.

instruction.text: Raina hears her belly rumbling. What does her body need? Choose the right advice for her.

b.sound: You’re getting hungry. You should sit down and have some lunch.
Your body wants to do some exercise. Keep working hard until you get tired.

instruction.text: What should Raina have for lunch after a morning full of hard work? Select the correct answer.

feedback.end: It’s not enough to just have a quick snack. Our bodies need a lot of food and water throughout the day.

instruction.text: Raina continues to fly after lunch and notices some smoke in the air. Where is the air fresher and easier to breathe? Select the correct answer.
Raina spots a forest fire creating all the smoke. It’s time to save the day! Choose the right advice for her.

b.sound: Be careful with the smoke! It makes it hard to breathe, so try not to fly right into it.
Throw your remaining snacks into the fire. Maybe it’ll help put it out!

instruction.text: Raina successfully puts out the fire with her rain! Her throat is dry after all the hard work. What does her body need? Select the correct answer.
Raina returns home after saving the day! How were all of her basic human needs met today? Drag the images to the correct group.
